verdict.rationale: NY DOS publishes a paper rail alongside online filing: mail the completed Certificate of Incorporation with the $125 fee to the Division of Corporations. It provides a form you may use or replace with your own, a Credit Card/Debit Card Authorization Form for paper payment, and a phone line at (518) 473-2492. However, the quoted evidence names only the recipient office, not a full street mailing address, and no fax number or fax procedure appears. Missing for 10: exact street mailing address in the evidence, published fax number/fax filing procedure, direct form identifiers/links, independent corroboration that the paper rail works when online filing is down.
